newsitem.title: UK: Brunswick launches new $125 mln Russia fund.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick launches new $125 mln Russia fund.

text.p: Brunswick Capital Management (BCM) said on Monday it had launched a new $125 million fund investing in relatively unknown Russian equities.
It said the Brunswick Russian Capital Appreciation closed-end fund was fully subscribed and attracted interest from European and U.S. institutional investors.
It will be incorporated in the Cayman Islands and plans to list on the Dublin Stock Exchange within a year.
Brunswick last year launched the $120 million Russian Growth Fund.

BCM chairman Jose Peman said the emerging equities to be targeted had a valuable asset base and exhibited high earnings improvement potential, which may lead to greater liquidity and possible entry into the blue-chip mainstream.

"While many Russian blue-chip shares have recently enjoyed an extended period of dramatic appreciation, emerging equities may now be poised to fuel a new growth surge in Russian capital markets," he said.
Brunswick senior portfolio manager Mark Cooke will have primary responsibility for the fund.
